package.name: robot_real_goal_manager
package.description:
Goal-input frontend for the G1 A*+MPC stack.
Provides two complementary entry points: - goal_relay_node : RViz "2D Goal Pose" (/goal_pose) → /global_goal - mission_runner_node: sequences goals from a YAML mission file, advancing when the robot reaches each waypoint. Used for reproducible benchmark trials.
